<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    rs=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for nm,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in {'L':(15,40,5,30),'T':(20,40,40,60),'S':(40,58,0,62)}.items():
        cs=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if rs[r][c] in ('B','S')]
        if not cs: out[nm]=None; continue
        rr=[r for r,c in cs]; cc=[c for r,c in cs]
        out[nm]=(min(rr),min(cc),max(rr),max(cc),len(cs))
    return out
